stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to complete a shopping exchange and solve one simple everyday problem. The central language is integrated A1 shopping and help review. It belongs to the practical context of shopping & everyday english. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “I'd like this shirt in blue, please.” and “It's too small; can you help me?” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: integrated A1 shopping and help review.
